statement: Pinned rnconrad device-side emulator initializes each Nunchuk/Classic 0xA4 register image by duplicating a 16-byte calibration template at offsets 0x20 and 0x30. Pinned Dolphin instead fills only 0x20 and resets the separate 0x30-0x3F field to zero. The two implementations conflict; neither establishes physical register contents or factory defaults.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical hardware variant not established
applicability.scope: rnconrad wiimote.c:795-809; Dolphin Extension.h:78-80, Extension.cpp:124-127, Nunchuk.cpp:117-143 and Classic.cpp:150-175. Software-model disagreement. Subpage cross-references: wii-gap-wiibrew-nunchuk-stick-center-calibration and wii-gap-wiibrew-classic-power-on-center do not authenticate an OEM 0x30 copy; preserve conflict with Dolphin and physical uncertainty.
